# opwan_account (Data Source)

The account the API token belongs to: its addresses, subscription and this month's usage.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "opwan_account" "this" {}

output "addresses" {
  value = [for a in data.opwan_account.this.addresses : a.ip]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `addresses` (Attributes List) The account's public IPv4 addresses. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--addresses))
- `created_at` (String) When the account was created (RFC 3339).
- `email` (String) The op account's email.
- `id` (String) The account id (UUID).
- `location` (String) The location the account chose, null before it chose one.
- `status` (String) `active`, `suspended` or `closed`.
- `subscription` (Attributes) The subscription, null without one. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--subscription))
- `usage` (Attributes) Data used this month (UTC). For daily figures or another month use the `opwan_usage` data source. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--usage))

<a id="nestedatt--addresses"></a>
### Nested Schema for `addresses`

Read-Only:

- `assigned_at` (String) When the account got it (RFC 3339).
- `assignment` (String) Where it goes: `tunnel`, `bgp` or `unassigned`.
- `block` (String) The block it was bought in (`72.244.89.16/30`), null for a single address.
- `ip` (String) The address (dotted IPv4).
- `location` (String) The address's location id.
- `tunnel_id` (String) The tunnel it's routed down, or for `bgp` the one announcing it now. Null when none.


<a id="nestedatt--subscription"></a>
### Nested Schema for `subscription`

Read-Only:

- `cancel_at_period_end` (Boolean) The subscription ends with the current period.
- `current_period_end` (String) End of the billing period (RFC 3339).
- `current_period_start` (String) Start of the billing period (RFC 3339).
- `extra_ips` (Number) Extra addresses on top of the first.
- `extra_tb` (Number) One-time data bought for the current month, TB.
- `monthly_tb` (Number) Monthly data add-on, TB, billed every month.
- `monthly_tb_counted` (Number) Monthly data in this month's allowance, TB.
- `peak_mbps` (Number) The speed ceiling, Mbps.
- `plan` (String) `base` or `plus`.
- `release_at` (String) After cancellation, when the addresses will be released.
- `status` (String) The Stripe subscription status (`active`, `past_due`, `canceled`, ...).
- `suspend_at` (String) While a payment is late, when the tunnel will be suspended.


<a id="nestedatt--usage"></a>
### Nested Schema for `usage`

Read-Only:

- `allowance_bytes` (Number) The plan's allowance plus this month's data add-ons.
- `month` (String) `YYYY-MM`.
- `rx_bytes` (Number) Bytes to you.
- `throttled` (String) Why the speed is lowered right now: `none`, `burst`, `allowance` or `pacing`.
- `tx_bytes` (Number) Bytes from you.
- `used_bytes` (Number) rx + tx, what counts against the allowance.
